note: Run with --env SCAN_SOURCE_DEFAULT=generated (postgres backend; the screener is the bed clone): with no file and no date, /analyze builds the scan for the pipeline's latest date, so with no retained scan it is the 'upload one first' 503 after the max(date) read; a typed generate_for still wins over the flag. A no-file analyze after an upload would generate the whole 3.9M-bar history in both desks and is deliberately not a case (16 GB machine shared with the live stack).
